    Mesh-weight gradings of A₀ and of its evaluated modules #

    weights-and-parameters.tex: "a mesh weight w grades V_{m+1}(C) by giving a path at row v the weight w(path) − ν_v, and grades U_m(C) …", and weights-and-parameters.tex: "Lift a basis of the integer ray weights to mesh weights using Lemma 7.4. These give simultaneous gradings on the lifted modules."

    A mesh weight W with values in an abelian group M is a path weight for which all meshes are homogeneous (MeshWt.homog), so it grades every Hom space of C (wπ), compatibly with composition and with the length grading (wπ_degProj). It grades A₀ (grA0, latA0) and each evaluated module M_X (grEv); the action of a homogeneous element of A₀, the arrow maps and all evaluated morphisms shift weights (act_shift, fA_shift, rs_shift), and an evaluated morphism shifting by γ comes from the weight-γ part of C (mem_wP_of_shift).

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.MeshWt.pw_comp {V : Type} [Quiver V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] (W : MeshWt Q M) {x y : V} (p : Quiver.Path x y) {z : V} (q : Quiver.Path y z) :
    W.pw (p.comp q) = W.pw p + W.pw q
